newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss Exchange adjusts SMI for Ciba SC spin-off.
newsitem.headline: Swiss Exchange adjusts SMI for Ciba SC spin-off.

text.p: The Swiss Exchange said it had adjusted the Swiss Market Index to reflect the introduction of trading in subscription rights for shares of Ciba Specialty Chemicals Holding Inc.
Ciba SC is being spun off from Novartis. Subscription rights began trading today.

The exchange said it adjusted Novartis shares by the value of the right, which it calculated at 79 Swiss francs by taking the last grey market price, adding this to the minimum price offered by a bank consortium and dividing by two.
Rights were quoted at 99.80 francs around 1300 GMT.
Subscription rights for Ciba will be incorporated into the SMI and the SwissIndex Family, so the index capitalisation remains unchanged, it said in a statement.

"At the end of the rights trading period from 26 February to 11 March 1997, the rights will be delisted with effect from 13 March 1997 and the speciality chemical shares will be incorporated in the SMI on a one-for-one basis at the closing price of the delisted rights plus nominal value of 10 francs," it said.
